name: Toki Nozomi
source:
Precise height: 164.3 cm

A girl in class 2-F who is the president of the photography club specializing in taking pictures of cats. Her trademark is her headphones which are always with her. While she is popular and has lots of friends, she is actually shy and doesn't know how to rely on people when she needs help.
